import csv,io
lab='''patient_id,hgb_raw,glucose_raw
NOR-001,15474,10152
NOR-002,15754,13977
NOR-003,11088,10122
NOR-004,14312,9573
NOR-005,16227,12268
NOR-006,12910,10947
NOR-007,14268,10323
NOR-008,11001,14441
NOR-009,12799,7148
NOR-010,11441,12581
NOR-011,16117,11805
NOR-012,16154,7507
'''
rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(lab)))
h=[int(r['hgb_raw'])*0.001013 for r in rows]
g=[int(r['glucose_raw'])*0.01007 for r in rows]
print(len(rows),h,sum(h)/len(h),g,sum(g)/len(g))
print(round(sum(h)/len(h),2),round(sum(g)/len(g),2))
PY
